schema: CREATE TABLE doctors (doctor_id INT, department_id INT, years_of_experience INT);
sql: SELECT department_id, AVG(years_of_experience) as avg_experience FROM doctors GROUP BY department_id HAVING AVG(years_of_experience) > 10;

schema: CREATE TABLE surgeries (surgery_id INT, patient_id INT, surgery_date DATE, surgery_type VARCHAR(50));
sql: SELECT surgery_type, COUNT(*) as num_surgeries FROM surgeries GROUP BY surgery_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

schema: CREATE TABLE patient_visits (visit_id INT, patient_id INT, visit_date DATE, visit_duration INT);
sql: SELECT visit_date, COUNT(*) as num_visits FROM patient_visits GROUP BY visit_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

schema: CREATE TABLE medications (medication_id INT, patient_id INT, medication_name VARCHAR(50), dosage INT);
sql: SELECT medication_name, SUM(dosage) as total_dosage FROM medications GROUP BY medication_name HAVING SUM(dosage) > 1000;

schema: CREATE TABLE patients (patient_id INT, department_id INT, admission_date DATE);
sql: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) as num_patients FROM patients GROUP BY department_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;
